description: Defines functions and classes for extracting and computing dispatch keys in PyTorch, including DispatchKeyExtractor and related utilities.

classes.name: MultiDispatchKeySet
classes.description: Utility to extract dispatch keys from various argument types.

classes.name: DispatchKeyExtractor
classes.description: Class to extract dispatch keys from operator call arguments, supporting both boxed and unboxed dispatch.

methods.name: computeDispatchKeySet
methods.description: Calculates the actual dispatch key set for a tensor, considering TLS and backends.

methods.name: MultiDispatchKeySet.operator()
methods.description: Extracts dispatch keys from different tensor-related argument types.

methods.name: multi_dispatch_key_set
methods.description: Utility function to get dispatch key set from multiple arguments.

methods.name: DispatchKeyExtractor.make
methods.description: Creates a DispatchKeyExtractor instance based on a function schema.

methods.name: DispatchKeyExtractor.registerSchema
methods.description: Registers a function schema for dispatch key extraction.

methods.name: DispatchKeyExtractor.getDispatchKeySetBoxed
methods.description: Extracts dispatch key set from boxed operator call stack.

methods.name: DispatchKeyExtractor.getDispatchKeySetUnboxed
methods.description: Extracts dispatch key set from unboxed arguments.

methods.name: DispatchKeyExtractor.setOperatorHasFallthroughForKey
methods.description: Sets whether an operator has fallthrough for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: DispatchKeyExtractor.dumpState
methods.description: Returns a string representing the internal state for debugging.

methods.name: DispatchKeyExtractor.checkInvariants
methods.description: Checks internal consistency of the extractor against a schema.
